item.title: Mommy-to-be Sonam Kapoor radiates elegance as she flaunts her baby bump at Mumbai event
item.description: Sonam appeared extremely mindful while walking at the event and was often seen gently holding her baby bump in a protective and affectionate manner. She smiled warmly as she interacted with people and acknowledged the paparazzi, exuding confidence and serenity.

item.title: Double-decker bus carrying pilgrims overturns on Agra highway, ten injured
item.description: A major road accident occurred on the Agra Highway in the Jaswantnagar area of Etawah district, when a double-decker bus carrying pilgrims overturned after the driver lost control of the vehicle. Around 45 pilgrims were on board the bus at the time of the accident. Approximately ten pilgrims sustained injuries and were admitted to hospital for treatment. item.title: ‘Schitt’s Creek’ star Catherine O’Hara passes away at 71 after brief illness
item.description: Born in Toronto, Canada, Catherine O’Hara began her journey in entertainment with the iconic Canadian sketch comedy series Second City Television (SCTV), which she co-created alongside Eugene Levy.

item.title: Kareena Kapoor calls bestie Amrita Arora her ‘sunshine in the rain’ on her birthday
item.description: Kareena shared a cheerful reel on Instagram featuring moments with Amrita, set to the evergreen Whitney Houston track I Wanna Dance with Somebody (Who Loves Me). The video reflected the duo’s long-standing friendship and easy camaraderie.

item.title: Not consulted on Sunetra's elevation; Ajit was to announce decision on reunion of NCP factions on Feb 12: Sharad Pawar
item.description: Amid rapid political developments in Maharashtra after the demise of Deputy Chief Minister Ajit Pawar in an air crash, NCP supremo Sharad Pawar on Saturday clarified that he was not consulted regarding Sunetra Pawar’s elevation as the Deputy CM. item.title: Sanjay Mishra and Neena Gupta stun with retro-glam looks ahead of Vadh 2 release
item.description: Sharing the visuals on Instagram, Mishra and Gupta surprised fans by stepping into sharply stylised, vintage-inspired looks that contrast with their typical grounded screen personas. The pair captioned the photos, “Serving killer looks. Hiding killer secrets,” a teaser that echoes the intense themes hinted at in the film’s recently released trailer.

item.title: Trump signals that a peace deal is within reach, though profound interpersonal tensions between Putin and Zelenskyy complicate the negotiation process.
item.description: US President Donald Trump said Friday that he saw instigation toward ending Russia’s war against Ukraine, though he added disunion between Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelensky and Russian President Vladimir Putin remained a major manacle to peace accommodations.

item.title: V of BTS ranks among world’s most searched personalities in 2025, outpacing Ronaldo and Messi in global search trends
item.description: Beyond search metrics, V continues to cement his influence in music and culture. He has been recognised as one of the most impactful global music influencers on social platforms, eclipsing well-known Western artists in several digital engagement lists.

item.title: Communication breakdown in the Pawar family: Sharad Pawar claims he had no knowledge of Sunetra Pawar’s sudden swearing-in.
item.description: Sunetra Pawar arrived at Devgiri, her late husband’s official residence in south Mumbai on Saturday morning along with son Parth.
